name: Pullman Danang Beach Resort
short_description: A 186-room beachfront resort on the white sands of Bac My An Beach, with an infinity pool, spa, and the closest resort location to both downtown Da Nang and the airport.
ai_summary: Pullman Danang Beach Resort sits directly on Bac My An Beach along My Khe, offering 186 rooms and cottages -- rooms with private balconies, cottages overlooking private gardens -- and is the closest beach resort to both downtown Da Nang and the international airport at around 15 minutes. An infinity pool, spa with sauna and jacuzzi, and the all-day Restaurant Epice round out the amenities. Guests consistently praise the beachfront setting, spacious rooms, proactive service, and breakfast buffet, with a serene, private-beach feel that suits both family and romantic stays.

core_facts.address: 101 Vo Nguyen Giap Street, Khue My Ward, Ngu Hanh Son District, Da Nang 550000, Vietnam

pros: Directly on Bac My An Beach, the closest resort to both downtown Da Nang and the airport
186 rooms and cottages, many with private balconies or garden views
Infinity pool and spa with sauna and jacuzzi
Restaurant Epice for all-day dining by the sea
Guests consistently praise the beachfront setting and cleanliness
cons: A subset of reviews note noise in the breakfast area and additional charges for specific amenities
As a large beach resort, the grounds require some walking between the beach, pool, and rooms
research_highlights: The private beach and infinity pool are called standout features
Room spaciousness and cleanliness draw consistent praise
The breakfast buffet's variety is repeatedly highlighted
research_watchouts: A minority of guests mention hidden costs for certain beach and pool amenities

faqs.question: Is Pullman Danang Beach Resort directly on the beach?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it sits directly on the white sands of Bac My An Beach along My Khe, with private beach access, and is the closest beach resort to both downtown Da Nang and the international airport.

faqs.question: Does Pullman Danang Beach Resort have cottages?
faqs.answer: Yes -- alongside standard rooms with private balconies, the resort offers beachfront cottages overlooking private gardens, part of its 186 total rooms and cottages.
